article.title: Effectiveness of eHealth Interventions in Alleviating Burden on Informal Caregivers of People With Dementia: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
article.authors: Liang M, Rong J, Grosan C
article.abstract: Informal caregivers of people with dementia frequently experience substantial psychological burden, including elevated stress and depressive symptoms. eHealth interventions have emerged as a scalable solution to support caregivers. However, their effectiveness and the influence of intervention characteristics remain unclear.
